source_caption:
Grown Ups is a comedy about five childhood friends who reunite after their basketball coach passes away. The group—played by Adam Sandler, Kevin James, Chris Rock, David Spade, and Rob Schneider—decide to spend a weekend together with their families at a lakeside house. As adults, they’ve all taken very different paths in life, but coming back together brings out their old friendships, jokes, and rivalries.

Throughout the weekend, the film focuses on their attempts to reconnect with each other and teach their kids the value of simple living, away from technology and busy city life. There are plenty of humorous moments, including silly competitions, family chaos, and nostalgic throwbacks to their younger days. In the end, the movie highlights themes of friendship, growing up without losing your inner child, and appreciating the people who matter most.

source_details.synopsis: Grown Ups is a 2010 American comedy film starring Adam Sandler, Kevin James, Chris Rock, David Spade, and Rob Schneider. The film was directed by Dennis Dugan, and written by Sandler and Fred Wolf. Salma Hayek, Maria Bello, and Maya Rudolph appear in supporting roles. The film's plot tells the story of five lifelong friends who won their junior high school basketball championship in 1978. They reunite three decades later for a 4th of July weekend after learning about the death of their former coach.
